Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, preferred name, canonical SMILES, maximum clinical phase, and first approval year. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records as an inner join to enforce at least one compound record. Left join compound_structures to include canonical SMILES when available. Filter molecules where max_phase is 3 or 4. Sort by molecule ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, max_phase, and first_approval.
